fields.title: Week of Nov 2 – Nov 8
fields.headline: 11 of 16 projects on track; Kestrel is the one at risk, $612K of contract value.
fields.body:
**On track: 11 of 16.** Daybreak’s holiday campaign goes live Nov 10.

**At risk**
- **Kestrel Air loyalty app** — SOW amendment 2 unsigned; unbilled work is building.

**Watch**
- **Harlow Hotels booking site** — the booking-engine integration is running long.
- **Brightwater brand refresh** — a third logo round was requested.

**Check-ins overdue**
- **Elmstead College** — last spoke Oct 22.

fields.title: Week of Nov 9 – Nov 15
fields.headline: $1.31M of contract value sits in 3 at-risk projects; $560K of work is unbilled.
fields.body:
**Contract value at risk: $1,312,000 of $4,102,000 (32%)**, up from $612,000. **9 of 16** projects on track, down from 11. **Unbilled work: $560,000**, a third of it on Kestrel.

**At risk**
- **Harlow Hotels booking site** — score 12, $486K. Integration 170 hours over; launch 18 days late; three change requests unsigned. Action: re-plan with the CMO by Nov 20.
- **Kestrel Air loyalty app** — score 24, $612K. $188K unbilled for 74 days behind SOW amendment 2. Action: CFO call Nov 17.
- **Brightwater brand refresh** — score 44, $214K. 91% of budget for 70% of work. Action: change order — **overdue since Nov 13**.

**Check-ins overdue**
- **Elmstead College** (25 days) — booked for this week.
- **Brightwater** (20 days) — at risk as well.
- **Juno Pet Care** (18 days) — not booked yet.

**Decisions for Monday**
1. Stop unsigned scope on Harlow until CR-14 to CR-16 are signed.
2. Escalate Kestrel’s amendment if it is not signed by Nov 18.
3. Price Brightwater’s extra rounds this week.
